title: Returns and refunds
text: Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Refunds are sent to the original payment method within five business days after inspection.

title: Standard shipping
text: Standard shipping takes three to five business days. Orders over 50 dollars qualify for free standard shipping.

title: Express delivery
text: Express delivery takes one to two business days and costs 12 dollars. It is unavailable for PO boxes.

title: Product warranty
text: Electronics include a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered.

title: Plus membership
text: Plus membership costs 8 dollars per month and includes free express delivery and early access to selected sales.

title: Customer support
text: Customer support is available by chat Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern Time.

title: Legacy shipping promotion
text: All orders qualify for free same-day shipping under the legacy launch promotion.
